mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 4.57% is below the historical average of 5.0%, compressing discount rates and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 4.57%, or the rank IC of FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the rank IC of FEDFUNDS on 20-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 300, it signals a high-inflation, high-rate environment that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 300, or the rank IC of the interaction signal on 20-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a positive growth rate in employment (PAYEMS > 0.5% month-over-month) signals a strong labor market that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5 AND PAYEMS growth > 0.5%, or the rank IC of PAYEMS growth on 20-day returns in the low unemployment regime is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1300 thousand units, it signals a correction in the housing market that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in potential policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1300, or the rank IC of HOUST on 20-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 103, it signals strong economic activity that may lead to monetary policy tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 103, or the rank IC of INDPRO on 20-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of real GDP (GDPC1) at 20187.495 billion of chained 2017 dollars is above the 2022 Q4 level, signaling sustained economic expansion that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 is at or above the current level (20187.495), or the rank IC of GDPC1 on 60-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 300.5, it signals persistent high inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary policy tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300.5, or the rank IC of CPIAUCSL on 5-day returns is below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
